title: 第8章 陪睡一个月-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》
content:
第(1/3)页

    "李青山！"

    “吱吱……！”

    话音落下，眼前的木门打开，一名身段姣好，五官精致的姑娘便站在了李青山面前。

    极品！

    赵山杏绝对是那种极其标准的极品小美人！

    等到日后嫁了人！

    历经滋养后，将后天条件弥补完成，就能彻底蜕变成为大美人了。

    “进来吧！”

    “昨天晚上，三奎叔来过了。”

    赵山杏说罢，便将李青山朝着房间内带了进去，一股浓烈的中药味道便飘了过来。

    堂屋一侧的卧室床上，一名四十多岁的中年男人，正坐在床上，见李青山进来后声音虚弱的朝着旁边椅子拍了拍道：“来，坐吧！”

    “哎！”

    李青山点头，坐在了赵占山旁边的椅子上，开口道：“占山叔，你这伤大夫怎么说？没什么大碍吧？”

    “唉！”

    赵占山忍不住长叹一口气，眼神中闪过一抹失落道：“从此以后，恐怕是上不得山了。”

    “青山啊，这上山可不是去玩闹的。”

    “你真的考虑清楚了，一定要上山吗？”

    赵占山跟大山打了一辈子交道，见过不少猎人死在山上，也知晓这大山的凶险，但前段时间还是着了道。

    若不是正好被关系好的猎户碰到。

    恐怕。

    这个世上，再也不会有赵占山的踪迹。

    能够从山上活着下来，赵占山就已经知足了。

    “占山叔，我考虑清楚了。”

    “这山，我是一定要上的。”

    李青山语气坚毅，郑重的点了点头道。

    “既如此，我也就不多说什么了。”

    “这上山最重要的是保命，其次才是狩猎，咱们上山狩猎，有些禁忌你得记住了。”

    “初一十五不上山……！”

    ……

    赵占山拖着虚弱的身子，将这大山上的禁忌和注意事项，包括用什么陷阱，抓什么猎物，如何布置陷阱，大概的都和李青山讲了一遍。

    直到太阳升起的时候，赵占山还是有些意犹未尽。

    这几十年狩猎的生涯，为赵占山积累了大量的经验，可以说这辈子赵占山就是大山的孩子。

    若是自己能够站起来，还是想要上山。

    即使是死在山上。

    赵占山的婶子太虚，没讲两句，便会忍不住咳嗽两声，到了后面完全不能说话，一直在咳嗽，想必是伤到了心肺。

    “爹，大夫说了！”

    “你的身子，要少说话！”

    赵山杏语气不悦的走了进来，盯着赵占山道。
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

"Li Qingshan!"

"Zhizhi...!"

After the words fell, the wooden door in front of him opened, and a girl with a good figure and exquisite features stood in front of Li Qingshan.

Excellent!

Zhao Shanxing is definitely the kind of extremely standard little beauty!

Wait until you get married in the future!

After being nourished and the acquired conditions are compensated, you can completely transform into a great beauty.

"Come in!"

"Uncle Sankui came last night."

After Zhao Shanxing said that, he took Li Qingshan into the room, and a strong smell of Chinese medicine wafted over.

On the bed in the bedroom on one side of the main room, a middle-aged man in his forties was sitting on the bed. When he saw Li Qingshan come in, he patted the chair next to him in a weak voice and said, "Come on, sit down!"

"Hey!"

Li Qingshan nodded, sat on the chair next to Zhao Zhanshan, and said, "Uncle Zhanshan, what do you think the doctor said about your injury? It's nothing serious, right?"

"Alas!"

Zhao Zhanshan couldn't help but let out a long sigh, and with a flash of disappointment in his eyes, he said: "From now on, I'm afraid I won't be able to climb the mountain."

"Qingshan, going up the mountain is not just for fun."

"Have you really thought carefully about it? Do you have to go up the mountain?"

Zhao Zhanshan has been dealing with mountains all his life. He has seen many hunters die on the mountains. He also knows the dangers of this mountain, but he still got the hang of it some time ago.

If you don’t happen to be bumped into by a well-connected Orion.

    I am afraid.

There will never be a trace of Zhao Zhanshan in this world.

Zhao Zhanshan would be satisfied if he could come down from the mountain alive.

"Uncle Zhanshan, I've thought about it carefully."

“I must climb this mountain.”

Li Qingshan’s tone was firm and he nodded solemnly.

"That being the case, I won't say anything more."

"The most important thing when going up the mountain is to save your life, followed by hunting. We are going up the mountain to hunt. You have to remember some taboos."

“I won’t go up the mountain on the first and fifteenth day of the Lunar New Year...!”

……

Zhao Zhanshan dragged his weak body and roughly told Li Qingshan the taboos and precautions on this mountain, including what traps to use, what prey to catch, and how to lay traps.

Until the sun rises, Zhao Zhanshan still has some unfinished ideas.

Zhao Zhanshan has accumulated a lot of experience in his hunting career for decades. It can be said that Zhao Zhanshan is the child of Dashan in this life.

If you can stand up on your own, you still want to go up the mountain.

Even if you die on the mountain.

Zhao Zhanshan’s aunt was too weak. She couldn’t help coughing twice without saying a few words. Later, she couldn’t speak at all and kept coughing. She must have hurt her heart and lungs.

"Dad, the doctor said it!"

"You should talk less about your body!"

Zhao Shanxing walked in with an unhappy tone and stared at Zhao Zhanshan.
